name: Teamwork
definition: We stimulate personal and professional growth, share the opportunities of development and maximize individual and team performance.

rows.situation: When someone is ready for more
rows.under: Keeps them in the role they already do well.
rows.justRight: Gives them the next stretch and the support to survive it.
rows.over: Promotes them into a hole the team needed filled, whether they are ready or not.

rows.under: Keeps it. Development is something other people should get.
rows.justRight: Shares the opportunity, including the ones that would have made you look good.
rows.over: Hands off every interesting problem, and you stop being useful on the work.

rows.under: Works around them. Their performance is their problem.
rows.justRight: Helps them get better, in the work, before deciding they cannot.
rows.over: Carries them indefinitely, and the rest of the team learns that struggling is a strategy.

rows.situation: When one person can finish it alone
rows.under: Lets them, and the team learns nothing.
rows.justRight: Uses the work to raise the team's capability, even if it takes longer.
rows.over: Forces pair work on tasks that one skilled person should just finish.

rows.situation: When the team ships something good
rows.under: Tells the story as a solo. The others become supporting cast.
rows.justRight: Makes the real contributions visible, including the unglamorous ones.
rows.over: Spreads credit so evenly that the people who did the hard part cannot be found.

rows.situation: When one person is far ahead of the others
rows.under: Builds the plan around the star, and everyone else becomes a helper.
rows.justRight: Uses the star to raise the team's ceiling, not to replace the team.
rows.over: Slows the star to the team's average so that nobody feels behind.
